label: smePro
doc: smePro (Tauri + SQLCipher). Database: <Tauri app data dir>/com.smepro.app/erp.db, encrypted with the raw key in erp.db.key beside it. Verified against smePro schema version 43.

scope.sql: SELECT id, name, currency FROM businesses ORDER BY created_at, id

streams.doc: Each sales row, with revenue as smePro keeps it (already net of refunds, exactly what its own dashboard adds up).
streams.sql: SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) AS id, sale_date AS date, created_at AS instant, revenue AS amount, quantity, NULLIF(TRIM(branch), '') AS location, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(customer), ''), NULLIF(TRIM(customer_phone), '')) AS customer, NULLIF(TRIM(item_name), '') AS product, order_id AS m_order_id, payment_method AS m_payment_method, cost_at_sale AS mm_cost, discount_amount AS mm_discount FROM module_sales WHERE business_id = :business_id AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(id AS TEXT)

streams.doc: Refunds are reported on their own so refund spikes can be watched. They are not subtracted again from sales, which smePro has already reduced.
streams.sql: SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) AS id, created_at AS instant, refund_amount AS amount, quantity_refunded AS quantity, NULLIF(TRIM(customer), '') AS customer, NULLIF(TRIM(item_name), '') AS product, reason AS m_reason, restocked AS m_restocked, sale_id AS m_sale_id FROM module_refunds WHERE business_id = :business_id AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY CAST(id AS TEXT)

streams.doc: Stock received (quantity x unit cost), counted when received.
streams.sql: SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) AS id, order_date AS date, created_at AS instant, quantity * unit_cost AS amount, quantity, NULLIF(TRIM(supplier), '') AS supplier, NULLIF(TRIM(item_name), '') AS product, po_number AS m_po_number FROM module_purchasing WHERE business_id = :business_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND received = 1 ORDER BY CAST(id AS TEXT)

streams.doc: Expenses typed into Bookkeeping by a person (rent, wages, transport...). Entries smePro posts by itself (purchases, refunds, debt settlements, repack rounding) are left out because they repeat records counted elsewhere.
streams.sql: SELECT CAST(id AS TEXT) AS id, transaction_date AS date, created_at AS instant, amount, NULLIF(TRIM(category), '') AS product, description AS m_description, payment_method AS m_payment_method FROM module_accounting WHERE business_id = :business_id AND deleted_at IS NULL AND LOWER(TRIM(entry_type)) = 'expense' AND NOT ((LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'purchasing' AND description LIKE 'Purchase received — %') OR (LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'refunds' AND description LIKE 'Refund — %') OR (LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'debt & credit' AND (description LIKE 'Debt settled — %' OR description LIKE 'Credit settled — %')) OR (LOWER(TRIM(category)) = 'stock revaluation' AND description LIKE 'Repack rounding %')) ORDER BY CAST(id AS TEXT)
